title: Revelation of God
definition: The revelation of God is His gracious act of making Himself, His will, His works, and His salvation known.
summary: God makes Himself known through creation, Scripture, and supremely through Jesus Christ.
christFocus: Jesus is the fullest revelation of God, making the Father known and accomplishing His saving purpose.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is not discovered by human effort alone. He makes Himself known. Creation reveals His power and glory, conscience bears witness to moral accountability, and Scripture reveals His saving truth.

The fullest revelation of God is Jesus Christ. In Him, God is made known personally, savingly, and finally.

Revelation is grace. God speaks so that His people may know Him, trust Him, worship Him, and obey Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Without revelation, people are left to speculation, idolatry, or confusion. The revelation of God matters because faith rests on what God has made known, not human imagination.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek God where He has revealed Himself. Pay attention to creation, submit to Scripture, and look to Christ as the fullest revelation of the Father.
